verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe a learning system that uses emoji reactions and explanatory replies on past review comments to adjust future reviews, so it stops flagging things the team doesn't care about after 2-3 weeks. Team conventions are captured through custom rules, coding patterns that can be created over MCP, and automatic indexing of existing rule files such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, all of which feed future reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the learned memory actually changes later reviews, and detail on how learned decisions are stored, inspected or edited over time.
